purpose: A working implementation experiment driven by durable specifications, without another runtime question loop.
authorization: The operator requested an actual working Go application on 2026-10-22. This does not fabricate acceptance of the contradictory older candidate specifications.
scope: Local n-player human/MCTS play, branching review and GIF export; authoritative Go server games between independently authenticated seats.

rules.wall: Implicit unplayable and uncapturable exterior. Wall itself is not a liberty for a player group. This corrects the older book's contradictory claim of immortal edge groups.
rules.capture: Place on Open; remove all adjacent opposing zero-liberty groups simultaneously; then remove the mover's zero-liberty group if no opponent was captured. Suicide is allowed.
rules.ledger: Flattened P by P matrix: off-diagonal captures positive, own-color removals negative on the diagonal. Every removed stone increases its owner's cumulative losses.
rules.score: Territory minus losses. An Open region belongs to a color only when its non-Wall boundary contains exactly that one player color; no colors or multiple colors are neutral. Captures give no separate bonus.
rules.repetition: Allowed, with cumulative losses retained. No ko prohibition is invented for this experiment.
rules.termination: One consecutive pass by each active player, one active player remaining after resignation, or the configured maximum turn count. Default maximum is 200; ties remain ties.
rules.deadline: Each turn has a 60-second deadline. If no valid action arrives, Pass is recorded. Browser search has a shorter adjustable work budget and never blocks the UI.

invariants.R1: Every legal action is one atomic immutable state transition; illegal actions leave the position unchanged.
invariants.R2: Losses, signed capture ledger and score derive from exactly the same position in both runtimes.
invariants.R3: Only the authenticated current seat may mutate a server game; stale revisions, spectators and other seats cannot play.
invariants.R4: Back, Forward and variation selection do not mutate a live network game. Local analysis may branch from a selected immutable node.
invariants.R5: GIF export replays only the chosen root-to-node actions through the authoritative rules, ends at that node, and writes only beneath the project runtime root.
invariants.R6: Requests, games, history, search work and exports have finite bounds. Errors carry specific messages; no identical automatic paid retries exist.

implementation.server: Go standard-library HTTP server, authoritative pure rules engine, atomic project-local snapshots, SHA-256 seat-token verifiers, same-origin mutation policy.
implementation.browser: Self-contained canvas UI with keyboard board navigation and semantic labels; pure JavaScript rules tested against Go; client-side Max-n MCTS in a dedicated worker.
security_tests: duplicate fields and invalid UTF-8 JSON
implementation.limits: At most 2048 local analysis positions, 512 turns per branch, 32 server rooms and 64 stored exports; exported lines contain at most 200 actions. No automatic retries or paid model requests.
implementation.evidence: make check writes a project-local test report; headless-browser evidence must exercise the actual served application.
